from.place: Lemma 05SC: LF sends distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles

title: Left derived functor preserves distinguished triangles
statement: In Situation 05S8 [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization], let $(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)$ be a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal D$. If $LF$ is defined at two of $X,Y,Z$, then it is defined at the third, and $(LF(X),LF(Y),LF(Z),LF(f),LF(g),LF(h))$ is a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal D'$, where $LF(f),LF(g),LF(h)$ are the maps between values of [lem-pur-derived-functor-morphisms-05sa] and the target $LF(X[1])$ of $LF(h)$ is identified with $LF(X)[1]$ by the canonical isomorphism of [lem-pur-derived-functor-shift-05su].
